fusions.name: Ride Them Down
fusions.desc: You charge up to 7 tiles to the target and trample it into your mesh, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Endless Circuit
fusions.desc: You ride a full circle trailing your mesh, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, always as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Second Wind in Harness
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Hauled Onward
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs dry, you lean into the harness of your mesh and regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
